title: DiscoveryDocument

environmentId.description: An environment's persistent id: a UUID made on its first start, kept across address changes.

environmentIcon.description: The environment's icon; absent from an environment that predates it.

environmentColour.description: The environment's colour; absent from an environment that predates it.

harnessVersion.description: The version of the harness the environment runs.

protocolVersion.description: A wire protocol version: one integer, bumped only on a breaking change.

capabilities.description: The capabilities an environment offers, as a set; an absent flag means unsupported.

authPolicy.description: How the environment is reached: local-only when it binds loopback alone, tailnet when it binds its tailnet address too. Both require a client session.

readiness.description: Whether the environment accepts work: starting (before its startup gate), ready, or draining (refusing new runs before a restart).

description: The unauthenticated discovery document: who the environment is (its id, name, icon and colour), what it speaks and offers, how it is reached and whether it is ready.
